paper_metadata.title: Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Ti high entropy alloys: A review of microstructural and mechanical properties at elevated temperatures

evidence.quote: An overview of the microstructural and mechanical properties of Al-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni-Ti high entropy alloys (HEAs) at high temperatures is presented.

RHEAs have the highest melting point compared to other HEAs [116 – 118] . However, the development of RHEAs has not yet reached its potential against high-temperature oxidation resistance and the balance between high-temperature strength and room-temperature ductility [119 – 123] .
The most commonly used materials for gas turbines in the aerospace and energy industries are superalloys [11 – 19] , especially Ni-based superalloys.

CoCrFeMnNi is the most familiar HEA containing, 3d-TM. The single-phase solid solution of these HEAs is known to offer the best combination of strength and toughness at cryogenic temperatures [126,127] , but is handicapped by its poor mechanical properties at high temperatures [128 – 130] .
